followup_explanation:
I routed to Dunlin-235B based on the capability evals most relevant to your request.

Your query is a creative writing task — generating a detailed, well-crafted Boruto scene. So I looked at the metrics that predict quality on that kind of work:

- **Creative Generation:** Dunlin 84.7 vs Lapwing 78.8 — a ~6 point gap, well above the 2.0-point variance threshold, so it's a meaningful difference favoring Dunlin.
- **Arena-Hard:** Dunlin 90.6 vs Lapwing 81.4 — this benchmark tracks open-ended, quality-judged responses, again favoring Dunlin.
- **General capability** (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, IFEval): Dunlin is ahead across the board, which helps with following your specific instructions (the 10-year timeskip, the family setup, the Hokage roles, and your "don't half-ass it" quality bar).

The task-preference notes in both models' docs only concern harm-adjacent or distasteful content, which doesn't apply to a wholesome family/fan-fiction scene — so those factors didn't enter into the decision. With nothing on the preference side to weigh, it came down purely to which model performs better on creative work, and that's clearly Dunlin.
